name: Organized Professional Team Sports, hearings before the Antitrust Subcommittee (Subcommittee No. 5), Committee on the Judiciary, House of Representatives, 85th Congress, 1st Session, 1957
stated_by: United States. Congress. House. Committee on the Judiciary. Antitrust Subcommittee

ACQUISITION_STATES._why_this_matters: Two different things reached this store from the same volume and they must never pool. The contract on 2748-2750 has a clean text layer and was PARSED. The salary table on 2567 is printed sideways on a 1-bit scan whose OCR is unusable, and every figure was READ BY EYE from a magnified image. A value a person read off a degraded scan is not the same kind of fact as one a machine extracted, and the difference has to survive into the store.
ACQUISITION_STATES.parsed_text_layer: machine-read from the PDF's embedded text
ACQUISITION_STATES.read_by_eye_from_scan: a human read the digits off a magnified page image; no OCR engine produced them

THE_ROSTER_SIZE_CHECK.what: total / mean should land on an integer -- the number of men paid. Nine of twelve clubs land on exactly 33.00 in most years and Detroit runs 36-39, so the divisor is a real roster count that varies by club and year.
THE_ROSTER_SIZE_CHECK._a_failing_cell_is_a_finding: 39 of 59 pass and 20 fail. A failing cell is written WITH its flag and its computed value. No digit was adjusted to make a check pass.
THE_ROSTER_SIZE_CHECK._what_it_cannot_catch: column misattribution. A value bound to the wrong club is internally consistent and passes every check. That happened on the first reading pass and was caught only by stitching each club's header into the same image as its figures.

NOT_WRITTEN.conference_standing: The conference (Western/Eastern) is recorded because it was read from the column anchors. The STANDING NUMBER was not: the OCR of those rows is garbled and no one read them by eye. An unread value is not written.
